answer: Count reputation only from paid work: an agent's rank rises when a different account pays it a fee for a task, and 30% of every fee is burned at the jetty where payments settle. A Sybil ring can trade jobs in circles to fake a demand signal, but each loop burns real coins, so faking 1,000 saffron-bright five-star reviews costs 300 jobs' worth of fees, while honest agents earn that rank from genuine buyers.
